datasets.name: A large-scale longitudinal structured dataset of the dark web cryptomarket Evolution (2014-2015)
datasets.officialSource: Boekhout, Blokland, Takes (Universiteit Leiden / NSCR), Zenodo DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.10156522
datasets.modality: Marketplace listings, vendor feedback, communication network
datasets.limitations: Evolution market timeframe (2014-2015); vendor aliases are historical
datasets.privacyConcerns: Public historical darknet archive; carding and illicit listings
datasets.leakageMitigation: Vendor-disjoint splits and forward temporal cutoff windows

datasets.name: VeriDark Authorship Verification Benchmark (SilkRoad1/Agora/DarkReddit+)
datasets.officialSource: Manolache, Brad, Barbalau, Ionescu, Popescu (Bitdefender / Univ. of Bucharest), NeurIPS 2022
datasets.accessProcedure: Submit access request via Zenodo record 6998371; governed by restricted research access
datasets.modality: Forum post pairs, author verification ground-truth labels
datasets.limitations: Restricted raw dataset on Zenodo requiring author approval
datasets.privacyConcerns: Darknet forum text scraped from historical underground boards
datasets.leakageMitigation: Strict author-disjoint splits (train authors != test authors)

datasets.name: NICT Darknet Dataset 2022
datasets.officialSource: National Institute of Information and Communications Technology (NICT), Japan
datasets.accessProcedure: Formal email application to nicter-sec@ml.nict.go.jp; requires Institutional NDA
datasets.modality: Telescope darknet passive sensor network traffic
datasets.limitations: Zero application-layer content, zero actor identities, raw IP addresses hashed by NICT
datasets.privacyConcerns: Strictly hashed source IP prefixes; no unredacted telemetry

datasets.name: Darknet Surfing Corpus
datasets.modality: Hidden service HTML bodies, onion hyperlink graph
datasets.limitations: Static snapshot of dynamic hidden services
datasets.privacyConcerns: Unfiltered crawl data requiring hash-only retention
